description: Scored US public sector briefs from official government data: product safety recalls (CPSC consumer products, NHTSA vehicles and equipment, FDA food), political money (FEC independent expenditures, Senate lobbying registrations and filings) and federal spending (USAspending award obligations by agency, Monthly Treasury Statement outlays, receipts and deficit). Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend versus the horizon, the inputs that drive it, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. POST /v1/brief with a small JSON body for one scored, cited brief; POST /v1/overview for all of them at once. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Body for POST /v1/brief (other routes take similar small bodies).

outputSchema.description: {service, vertical, title, status, score (0-100), label, trend, trend_basis, summary, drivers[], risk_flags[], confidence{score,label}, coverage, inputs[], watch[], citations[{url}], method}. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).

responseSummary.note: Fill from a live MainNet capture.
